tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current or forecast weather for a resolved location. Use for weather, temperature, rain, conditions, or clothing-planning questions; ask a clarifying question when the location is ambiguous.

location.description: City/region to query, with state or country when needed, e.g. Boston, MA.

time_window.description: Optional time such as now, today, tomorrow morning, or this weekend.

units.description: metric for Celsius/kmh, imperial for Fahrenheit/mph.

resolved_location.description: Location actually used by the weather provider.

units.description: Units used for numeric weather values.

observed_at.description: ISO timestamp for current weather freshness.

forecast_for.description: Time window covered when this is a forecast.

error.description: Optional problem such as ambiguous location or unavailable data.
